name: Amaysim
summary: Australian mobile MVNO on the Optus network, founded 2010 (ASX: AYS 2015-2021); entered broadband 2016 via AusBBS, launched NBN May 2017 with plans to build its own direct-to-POI network; exited broadband Oct 2018 (sold ~15,000 NBN customers to Southern Phone, cancelling the direct-to-POI rollout); acquired by Optus 2021; re-entered NBN Sep 2024 as an Optus NBN resale (AMAYSIM AUSTRALIA LIMITED, ACN 143 613 478).

events.details: Founded November 2010 (founders Peter O'Connell, Rolf Hansen, Christian Magel, Thomas Enge, Andreas Perreiter); MVNO on the Optus network; listed on the ASX as AYS July 2015.
Entered the broadband market by acquiring AusBBS for $4m (announced 19 Jul 2016), gaining its AAPT wholesale relationship.

refs.label: CRN: Amaysim enters broadband market with $4m acquisition (19 Jul 2016)

events.details: Launched as an NBN reseller (5 May 2017) at all 121 POIs (fixed + fixed-wireless), initially via AAPT and Optus wholesale aggregation, with plans to build its own direct links to selected NBN POIs ('hybrid network' / 'major new converged network').

refs.label: iTnews: Amaysim puts speeds at centre of NBN play (5 May 2017)

events.details: Exited broadband: sold all ~15,000 broadband customers to Southern Phone for $3m and stopped reselling broadband, citing 'unsustainably high wholesale costs', 'punitive' NBN wholesale costs, intense competition, and capital allocation. The planned direct-to-POI network rollout was cancelled.

refs.label: CRN: Amaysim exits broadband market after 18 months (Oct 2018)

events.details: Sold its energy retail business (Click Energy) to AGL for $115m (announced Sep 2020), separating energy from the mobile/broadband business ahead of the Optus takeover.

refs.label: Wikipedia: Amaysim (AGL acquires Click Energy for $115m, Sep 2020)

events.details: Optus acquired 100% of Amaysim for $250m (agreement 2 Nov 2020); Amaysim delisted 6 Apr 2021.

Re-entered the NBN market as a resold Optus NBN service (trial Jul-Aug 2024; official launch 18 Sep 2024); IPoE, real IPv4 (no CGNAT), no IPv6; plans from 25/10 up to NBN 500 with a bundle discount for Amaysim mobile customers.

refs.label: Whirlpool: 'Amaysim NBN' - re-entry and launch (Jun 2024 - Aug 2026)
